subject.title: [Bug]: Agent heartbeat routes to wrong agent's session instead of its own

question: Should maintainers keep this in live-repro/manual-review until a current-main Docker run shows where historian2 loses its agent id, or queue a source-only fix from the current suspicion?
rationale: Current source and tests already cover the obvious explicit-agent paths, but the reporter has fresh latest-release evidence that those paths are not enough in their Docker setup.

options.title: Run live Docker repro first
options.body: Reproduce the reporter's multi-agent Docker setup on current main and v2026.6.11, then patch the concrete dropped-agent path that appears in logs.

options.title: Queue speculative source fix
options.body: Let ClawSweeper attempt a fix against `resolveCronTarget` or manual wake targeting without first proving that this is the path failing in the user's setup.

options.title: Close as already implemented
options.body: Treat the stale-runtime fix from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/65085 as sufficient despite the newer reporter evidence.

recommendation.title: Run live Docker repro first
recommendation.body: Reproduce the reporter's multi-agent Docker setup on current main and v2026.6.11, then patch the concrete dropped-agent path that appears in logs.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent reviewer/current-file owner signal makes this the best available routing owner for deciding the proof bar before another fix attempt.
